newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Konka says B rights share offer fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Konka says B rights share offer fully subscribed.

text.p: Shenzhen Konka Electronic Group Co Ltd said on Tuesday its rights offer to B shareholders had been fully subscribed and completed.

Konka made a three-for-10 rights offer, priced at HK$5.85 each, to holders of B shares last month and raised HK$203.56 million, the maker of colour televisions said in a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The issue followed completion of a three-for-10 rights offer to holders of the firm's A shares and legal person shares in July, Konka said.

Earlier, a spokesman for Konka told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter, Konka's A share rights offer had produced net proceeds of 329.5 million yuan, used to expand television production and supplement working capital.
He said most proceeds from the B rights offer would go to the same projects as those from the A share offer.
These include construction of a 210,000-sq-metre electronics complex in the city of Dongguan, in Guangdong province, costing 150 million yuan, which will mainly turn out colour televisions, he said.
Some of the proceeds will be used to expand television sales abroad by setting up outlets in Hong Kong and Russia, he said.
Konka said in the notice it has 365.57 million outstanding shares, including 237.87 million founder shares, 79.28 million A shares, 48.33 million B shares and 86,266 staff shares.
